en: Sepia-toned historical street scene showing a festive horse-drawn carriage lavishly decorated with flowers. Two horses stand on a cobblestone street in front of a grand late‑19th/early‑20th‑century building. The carriage is covered with floral garlands and wheels wrapped in flowers; elegantly dressed men in top hats and women in large hats sit inside, one holding a parasol. A large crowd in period clothing gathers around and looks on from the street and the building's balconies. Signs with Cyrillic lettering are visible on the facade.
